title: Southern Seaplane

services.name: Air Charters
services.desc: Let one of our experienced fishing guides fly your party out to the beautiful Louisiana barrier islands for a day of surf fishing. Just forty-five minutes after you lift off from our facility at Belle Chasse, you’ll arrive at the unspoiled islands off the coast of Louisiana where big redfish and yellowmouth trout are waiting. Enjoy up to five hours of fishing in unspoiled surroundings than just board the plane for a relaxing forty-five-minute flight back to Belle Chasse. You will need fishing gear, tackle, food, and drinks. One 48quart ice chest per plane, please. Current LA fishing license required. (May be purchased online HERE). We can provide basic fishing gear if needed. Keep in mind
